definition result equals
    gift and (not discount) and (specific or producttype)
anchors.quote: Paragraph 3.11 of the Code of Conduct provides that distributors should not offer any gifts (other than a discount of fees or charges) in promoting a specific investment product or a particular type of investment product to a client.

assumptions: The distributor, promotion and client context is fixed by the question; the interface does not independently test that context.
The four supplied classifications are accepted as factual evidence. Either product linkage suffices, and a discount of fees or charges is excluded even when classified as a gift.
Actual investor distraction is not a separate condition: the source states it as the purpose of the prohibition.
interpretation: The quoted gift prohibition applies when the offered item is a gift, is not a discount of fees or charges, and the promotion is linked to a specific investment product or a particular type of investment product. A false result addresses only this prohibition, not compliance with other requirements.
